Suno – prompt (EN, à coller tel quel)

Melancholic chamber piece opens at 75 BPM in A minor: solo cello whispers a fragmented descending melody, phrases left incomplete and suspended. Felt piano adds sparse harmonic touches with prepared strings rattling softly; bowed harmonics shimmer in the high register. Delicate dissonances emerge and dissolve; intimate rubato passages drift between structured meter. The melody searches for resolution but never finds it, creating wistful longing. Loopable core 0:30-2:00. chamber, intimate, contemplative, sorrowful, introspective

Variantes requises

- Low/Med/High intensity · Instrumental · No percussion · Short loop [30s] · Stinger [1–2s]
